tagline.ru: Веб-аналитика на своём сервере — замена Google Analytics

notes: The database environment variables pre-fill the installation wizard, not config.ini.php; the first visitor must finish setup and create the superuser.
The app volume preserves configuration, plugins and GeoIP data written into the webroot across rebuilds.
Matomo connects with a dedicated database user, never MariaDB root; the app owns its URL configuration.
